Potential value of the network
For the EOSC:
• Enhance repository compliance with EOSC RoP 
• Help implement FAIR and TRUST assessments
9
For researchers:
• Facilitate researchers’ access to Long Term Preservation
For repositories:
• Promote adoption of FAIR and TRUST practices
• Strengthen the voice of TDRs in Europe
